title: Factorized layer x expert Tucker address
hypothesis: For a planted low-rank Tucker matrix bank of logical layer-expert transforms, a product of layer and expert coefficient factors will recover all held-out layer-expert combinations with test nMSE <= 1e-5 and use at least 20% fewer actual serialized bytes than a flat per-pair Tucker coefficient control. A direct low-rank coefficient product is the nearest non-Mirror control and may erase Mirror-specific value.
physical_object: shared Tucker core bank of 2 basis matrices representing 16x16 linear maps for 4 layers x 4 experts
mirror_coordinate: factorized layer code times expert code over shared Tucker bank
logical_multiplicity: 16 layer-expert transforms, including combinations held out from coefficient fitting
controls: single shared Tucker bank hard tie
ordinary rank-2 layer-factor x expert-factor coefficient product
Mirror layer/expert factor product over Tucker bank
independent full transform per pair upper control

development.selection_metric: held-out layer-expert test nMSE and serialized byte count

success_gate: All 3 fresh seeds: held-out test nMSE <= 1e-5, Mirror payload <=0.80x flat pair coefficient payload, and Mirror strictly smaller than the rank-2 ordinary coefficient-product control by at least 10%; exact serialized reload and metrics replay.
failure_gate: Mirror exceeds nMSE 1e-5 in >=2 fresh worlds; or saves <20% versus flat pairs in >=2; or ordinary product control is within 10% bytes at comparable quality; or compute proxy exceeds 10x flat control.
amendment: After development showed ordinary_product and mirror_product are the same mathematical coefficient-product family, the two controls now use paired identical initialization and minibatch seeds. The basis bank size is explicitly 2, matching the frozen rank-2 coefficient product. This amendment is committed before fresh access; success/failure gates and fresh seeds are unchanged.
boundaries: synthetic linear transform bank, not trained MoE or natural-language evidence
factorized coordinates are not independent capacity
actual inference payload bytes are authoritative
fixed-update learning evidence is not capacity
